ranking_metric: Debian popcon installations (sourcemax/by_inst), maximum over binary packages of the source package
selection: Highest popcon count among C++ JSON parser source packages in the 'json' source-name search: libjsoncpp (JsonCpp) 32,707, also highest at dev-package level (libjsoncpp-dev 2,203 vs nlohmann-json3-dev 1,799). C libraries in the same search (json-c, JSON-GLib, cJSON and libfastjson above it; yyjson below) are excluded from the C++ cell.
uncertainty: Pilot cell: only JsonCpp 1.9.8 was built and control-verified. Popcon measures Debian installs; JsonCpp's runtime count is inflated by dependents such as CMake, and header-only libraries (nlohmann/json, RapidJSON) have only dev packages, so popcon undercounts them. GitHub stars rank nlohmann/json first (50,894 vs 8,916). Nine leads are logged in leads.json and are not selected or ranked. Framework packages (Qt, Boost, POCO) are not ranked by whole-framework installs. The ISO C++ standard library has no JSON API. Two valid controls do not establish complete RFC 8259 support.
